stage: Fresh development confirmation, never final test
reference_variation: First reference JPEG quality 20, remaining three unchanged; all references remain same-person. Not an isolated reference-quality ablation.
primary_contrasts: low minus high strength on five partially degraded types
preserved high minus standard high on five partially degraded types
multiplicity: Holm over four identity-averaged primary tests; medium/severe strata and observed-input comparisons retained
selection: Fixed hash ranking; val split only; exclude all earlier training, inspected, attempted and reserved identity labels; exact and pHash<=6 duplicate exclusion; one-face detector screening
interpretation: Mask geometry and severity vary together; do not attribute cross-stratum differences solely to severity. Within-case method comparisons are paired. No promotion if output loses target fidelity against unchanged input.
